speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your fatigue and concentration issues, could you describe any changes in your diet, bowel habits, or recent illnesses? Also, have you noticed any unusual bleeding, bruising, or skin pallor?

text: 53-year-old male. The patient has a 3-week history of fatigue, difficulty to concentrate, and dyspnea on exertion. He also experiences dizziness and digital pain that improves with cold. He has a long history of smoking.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of Raynaud's phenomenon, and have you experienced any recent chest pain or shortness of breath at rest? I would also like to check if you have any clubbing of the fingers or signs of peripheral edema.
